answer: One defence is to anchor each agent identity to a single onyx hardware seal that cannot be copied without buying another device. To join the market, an agent locks 50 coins behind its seal, and every trade carries a signal proving the same seal approved it. Creating 200 fake agents would therefore need 200 seals and 10,000 coins locked, and if any clone cheats, its whole 50-coin deposit is burned. A spammer gains nothing from free copies, because each extra identity costs real hardware plus a deposit that can be destroyed.
